notes: Strong's usage list ("equally distant, set in order") reads differently from "be joined" -- BDB has no entry for this root in the available lexicon file, so the gloss is verified here against standard translation consensus instead: both attestations describe the tabernacle boards' tenons as מְשֻׁלָּבֹת אִשָּׁה אֶל־אֲחוֹתָהּ, "each fitted/joined to its sister [board]" -- several major translations (e.g. ESV) render this literally "joined to one another," directly supporting the requested gloss.
